propositions: Parallel multi-session compaction writes mutate the worktree (SNAPSHOT writes, retired renames, archived deletions) before git commit with no rollback on worker death, leaving dirty trees that cause git merge to abort on untracked files or tracked-file conflicts, orphaning local ticket commits and blocking attestations.
Tracked runtime markers (*/.archived, */.write.lock) committed before gitignore patterns existed remain tracked forever, causing routine marker churn to appear as persistent dirty tree state.

Compaction fold must achieve crash-atomicity via an intent journal (commit-pending sentinel stored outside the worktree) that enables recovery of abandoned partial folds under the write lock by reverting mutations when snapshot is uncommitted.

Union merge and push recovery must recover both abort variants (untracked-file collisions and tracked-deletion/modification conflicts) on regenerable store artifacts by restoring deleted tracked files from HEAD and quarantining modified ones.
Store-wide scans (fsck, compact-all) must default to active tickets only and accept --include-archived flag to reach full store, keeping scan cost proportional to the active working set.

fsck must detect dirty-tree/stale-lock classes (tracked deletions, untracked regenerable leftovers, orphaned locks) and doctor --repair must heal them safely under the write lock without modifying .tmp-event-* content.
